tei:div.tei:p: )bla ma rgyang 'bod byin rlabs sprin phung dngos grub char 'bebs thugs rje'i lcags kyu gdod ma'i myur lam bzhugs so// e ma skyabs med bdag gi skyabs gnas// 'dren mchog drin chen gyi bla ma// mtshan ldan thugs rje yi mnga' bdag /bdag med sprang po la gzigs dang*// kye hud chos med sdig ldan nga ni// sngon bsags kyis dal 'byor 'di thob kyang*// chos med du skye bo yi las bsags// byas pa kun sdig gi rang bzhin// e ma skyabs gnas pad+ma yi rgyal tshab// 'khrul med gsang sngags kyi bstan 'dzin// smin grol thar pa yi lam mkhan// thugs rjes da lta rang gzigs dang*// kye hud chos med btsun gzugs nga ni// thugs rje'i spyan snga ru mchis rung*// sangs rgyas mi gzugs su bstan nas// dag snang la 'byong dus su ma mchis// e ma sku mchog nyid rdo rje yi rang bzhin// ci gsung rnams gsang sngags kyi chos sgra// ci spyod kyang sgyu ma yi rol pa// ci mdzad rung gang 'dul gyi rnam 'phrul// kye hud smin grol rnams rim pa bzhin thob rung*// thos tshad kun rna dred du song nas// chos bsam rung phyi phyi ru lus nas// tshe 'dir zhen pas rang 'chings 'dug /e ma skyabs gnas dkon mchog gi ngo bo// mtsho brgal rtsod med kyi ded dpon// g.yul bzlog bslu med kyi dpa' bo// dbul sel yid bzhin gyi nor bu// kye hud chos gzugs tha mal du lus nga*// gshin rje 'chi bdag nyid byung nas// dbang med gcig pu ru khrid nas// mi ngas ci ltar du bya yi// e ma thugs rje chen po yi bla ma// yal yol btang snyoms su ma mdzad// da lta nyid du btud nas// 'khor ba'i 'dam nas drongs mdzod// kye hud nyin mo ni g.yeng ba yi ngang 'khyams// mtshan mo ni gti mug gi gnyid 'thib// bar skabs su lto gos kyi las 'brang*// ci byas kyang rang dbang du mi 'dug

/e ma/ ltos med bdag gi ltos sa bla ma rje// re med bdag gi re sa bla ma rje// skyabs med bdag gi 'bod sa bla ma rje// thugs rje mtshungs med drin chen bla ma rje// mkhyen no bla ma rin po che mkhyen no// gsol ba bdag gis mi 'debs na su yis 'debs// thugs rjes khyed kyis mi 'dzin na su yis 'dzin// blo snying khyed la mi gtad na su la gtad// lam mchog khyed kyis mi ston na gang gis ston// mkhyen no bla ma rin po che mkhyen no// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /sku yis lus la byin gyis rlobs shig /lus la bde drod 'bar bar mdzod cig /gsung gis ngag la byin gyis rlobs shig /ngag la nus pa 'bar bar mdzod cig /thugs kyis yid la byin gyis rlobs shig /sems la rtogs pa 'char bar mdzod cig /lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs shig /sku gsung thugs su 'grub par mdzod cig /mkhyen no bla ma rin po che mkhyen no// 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /nyal mal 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /thun 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /gdan thog 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /skad cig ma 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs shig /ces dbang bzhi blangs nas thugs yid gcig 'dres su mnyam par bzhag go /ces bla ma rgyang 'bod 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bsam gtan chos dbang dang*/ bsam gtan chos 'phel gnyis kyis bskul ba la brten nas gter sgrub chen mo'i thun mtshams su stag sham rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ thun bzhi'i gsol 'debs dmigs rim 'di/ skal ldan las 'phro can gyis nyams su longs/ dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i dgongs pa yin/ rang sems ngo bo skyong ba'i 'tsho rogs yod/ thun bzhi'i gsol 'debs dmigs rim ni/ dmigs skor sogs bla ma'i rnal 'byor las byung ba ltar gus pas sku bzhi dbang dang sbyar ba'i gsol 'debs 'di ltar gyis/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ston mchog sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo// mtshungs med drin chen gyi bla ma// rgyal dbang pad+ma yi yang sprul// mtshan ldan stag sham pa mkhyen no// bum dbang ye shes su bskur cig /lus phung dri ma kun dag nas// bskyed rim snang stong du 'char zhing*// sprul sku 'gro don du byin rlobs// bla ma stag sham rdo rje// mtshan ldan bsam gtan rdo rje// drin chen nus ldan rdo rje// gsol ba 'debs po la gzigs shig /yi dam longs sku yi ngo bo// mtshungs med drin chen gyi bla ma// 'phags mchog spyan gzigs kyi sku mchog /mtshan ldan nus ldan pa mkhyen no// gsang dbang nus ldan du bskur cig /ngag phung dri ma kun dag nas// rtsa rlung bzlas pa kun 'grub cing*// longs sku sgyu ma ru byin rlobs// bla ma stag sham rdo rje// mtshan ldan bsam gtan rdo rje// drin chen nus ldan rdo rje// gsol ba 'debs po la gzigs shig /chos sku dmigs med kyi rol pa/ mtshungs med drin chen gyi bla ma// kun bzang chos sku yi ngo bo// mtshan ldan bsam gtan pa mkhyen no// shes rab sems dbang du bskur cig /sems kyi dri ma kun dag nas// stong nyid phyag chen du rtogs nas// chos sku ye shes su byin rlobs// bla ma stag sham rdo rje// mtshan ldan bsam gtan rdo rje// drin chen nus ldan rdo rje// gsol ba 'debs po la gzigs shig /sku bzhi lhun grub kyi rol pa// mtshungs med drin chen gyi bla ma// ngo bo nyid sku yi bdag nyid// mtshan ldan mchog ldan pa mkhyen no// tshig dbang ngo bo la bskur cig /sgo gsum dri ma kun dag nas// rdzogs chen 'od sku ru grol zhing*// ngo bo gnyis med du byin rlobs// bla ma stag sham rdo rje// mtshan ldan bsam gtan rdo rje// drin chen nus ldan rdo rje// gsol ba 'debs po la gzigs shig /mngon par byang chub kyi ngo bo// mtshungs med drin chen gyi bla ma// rgyal ba kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid// drin chen bla ma nyid mkhyen no// byin rlabs yongs rdzogs su bskur cig

/nyon shes dri ma kun dag nas// zag med bde chen du la bzla// mngon par byang chub tu byin rlobs// bla ma stag sham rdo rje// mtshan ldan bsam gtan rdo rje// drin chen nus ldan rdo rje// gsol ba 'debs po la gzigs shig /ces bla ma sku bzhi'i ngo bo la dbang bzhi byin rlabs dang sbyar nas gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bzhi'i dmigs pa byin rlabs bka' babs kyi tshul du blangs nas/ mthar rang dang gnyis med du bsres nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ snang stong sgyu ma yi phung po// drin chen bla ma yis byin rlobs// sprul sku rdo rje yi rang bzhin// snang srid bla ma yi rol pa// ci shar der snang kun a la// ngo mtshar rmad byung gi dga' bde// o rgyan mkha' 'gro yi tshogs bcas// mchog ldan grub chen gyi bla ma// stag sham bka' drin ni 'khor med// gsol ba 'debs po la gzigs shig /chos med dred po la gzigs shig /las ngan 'khor ba nas drongs shig /grags stong ca co yi ngag la// yi dam rdo rje yis byin rlobs// longs sku rlung sngags kyi rol pa// 'byin 'jug rdo rje yi bzlas pa// ca co grags stong kun a la// snang grags rang snang la ngo sprod// o rgyan mkha' 'gro yi tshogs bcas// mchog ldan grub chen gyi bla ma// stag sham bka' drin ni 'khor med// gsol ba 'debs po la gzigs shig /ngan shor long gtam la gzigs shig /las rlung nag po 'di zlog cig /dran 'gyu pra dred kyi sems la// stong nyid phyag chen du byin rlobs// rtog tshogs chos sku yi rol pa// shar grol stong nyid du a la// gang shar stong nyid la ngo sprod// o rgyan mkha' 'gro yi tshogs bcas// mchog ldan grub chen gyi bla ma// stag sham bka' drin ni 'khor med// gsol ba 'debs po la gzigs shig /dug lnga'i yo langs la gzigs shig /rnam rtog gi rkun bu 'di zlog cig /sgo gsum dbyer med kyi rgyud la// sku bzhi bla ma yis byin rlobs// bya spyod chos nyid kyi rol pa// snang srid rab 'byams su a la// rkyen snang gdams ngag la ngo sprod// o rgyan mkha' 'gro yi tshogs bcas// mchog ldan grub chen gyi bla ma// stag sham bka' drin ni 'khor med// gsol ba 'debs po la gzigs shig

/'khrul 'byams don med la gzigs shig /mnog chung gi bslu brid 'di zlog cig /rjes thob snang srid bla mar lam khyer ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bde gshegs yongs 'dus kyi bla ma// rigs drug 'khor lo yi mgon po// rdor 'chang nus ldan gyi rdo rje// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yi mnga' bdag /pad 'byung yid bzhin gyi nor bu// khyod nyid kho na ru lags pas// gsol ba snying dkyil nas 'debs so// khyed kyi gsang gsum gyi ye shes// bdag rgyud sgo gsum dang dbyer med// sku bzhi'i ngo bo ru yongs smin// mtha' yas 'gro ba yi dpal mgon// tshad med phrin las kyi 'jug sgo// mthong thos dran reg kun rang grol// bla med byang chub du sbyor bar// khyed dang dbyer med du byin rlobs// sku gsum dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo// gzugs snang bla ma yi rol pa// sgra grags 'bru gsum gyi sngags dbyangs// dran rtogs ye shes kyi rol gar// ma bcos gnyug ma yi gshis lugs// ka dag rig pa yi 'char sgo// stong gsal phyag rgya cher a la// lhun grub snang bzhi yi 'phel tshogs// blo zad chos zad du la bzla// cir snang ci shar kun a la// khyed kyi gsang gsum las gzhan med// 'khor 'das snang srid kun rang grol// ye shes rab 'byams kyi dbyings las// gdos bcas dmigs su ni ma mchis// e ma ho/ ngo mtshar bsam brjod las 'das so// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku gsum 'pho 'gyur dang bral lo// rgyal ba'i thugs rje ni rmad byung*// gu ru'i rol gar dang nam yang*// 'bral med byin gyis rang rlobs shig /ces bla ma sku bzhi'i ngo bo ltar bya zhing gsol 'debs gong ma gnyis po dang sbrag nas thun bzhir gsol ba gdab pas byin rlabs phyogs med du 'byung ba gong 'og rten 'brel du snang yang*/ gang zag 'debs po rang gal che bar gda'// re dwogs 'gong po 'di bkag bzlog mkhan// mnyam 'dres 'phya sems 'di dgra dpung rags// nga bdag gzung 'dzin 'di lcags ri dam// le lo ngan shor 'di 'gro lam bde// dad med log lta 'di sgo mo dam// ma rig dug lnga 'di dmag dpung 'thug

/chos brgyad rgyal po 'di btsan rdzong mtho// nga che nga btsan gyi blon 'bangs mang*// bslu brid 'dod chags 'di btsun mo mdzes// rten 'brel ngan pa'i yo langs 'di byas tshe la// dag snang byin rlabs kun 'byung ba'i lam 'phrang dog /de phyir gsol ba 'debs lugs mdzod// ces khyi lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes la sgrub sde spyi yis gsol 'debs bla ma sku bzhi'i dbang bzhi dang mthar 'od zhu bcas dgos zhes sku skye pad+ma chos 'dzin brgyud nas bskul bzhin bris pa dge bar gyur cig /skabs 'gar bya bar spro na/ rgyal kun thugs rje gcig tu grub pa'i gzugs// bdag sogs mos ngor snang ba'i skyabs gcig pu// rigs drug 'khor lo'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// nus ldan rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// gsol 'debs 'di 'khor lo'i mgon po chos rje gling pas grub zhing chen po'i rta phag mdun gsungs rgyur stsal ba bcas byin rlabs nan ltar che bas brgya stong khri 'bum gang mang 'don/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'bru gsum sngags kyang bsnyen pa bye ba sogs gang 'gro bzla/ thun mjug bla ma'i rol par dran bzhin pas/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces smon lam gdab bo/// /
